tender.title: Institutional Strengthening and Capability Development Plan for Disaster Risk Management in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
tender.description:
DAI Global UK is seeking a firm to prepare an Institutional Strengthening and Capability Development Plan for Disaster Risk Management (DRM) in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), Pakistan. The assignment is delivered under Building Resilience and Addressing Vulnerability to Emergencies - Institutional Strengthening (BRAVE-IS), a multi-year (2026-2029) technical assistance programme funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO). The contracting organisation is DAI Pakistan Pvt. Ltd.

The firm will work with the Relief, Rehabilitation and Settlement Department, Government of KP, and its attached agencies: the Provincial Disaster Management Authority (PDMA), Rescue 1122 and the Civil Defence Directorate. The work is in four stages:
- Stage 1, Inception (weeks 1-2)
- Stage 2, Diagnostic and validation (weeks 3-6): institutional, financial, HR and digital systems assessment
- Stage 3, Recommendations and plans (weeks 7-12): a five-year Institutional Strengthening Plan for each of PDMA, Rescue 1122 and Civil Defence
- Stage 4, Early implementation support (weeks 13-36): implementation-ready products, commissioned at BRAVE-IS's discretion on completion of Stage 3

The contract is fixed price, with payment linked to acceptance of agreed deliverables. Personnel will be based in Peshawar, with field visits to selected districts of KP. The firm must propose four Key Persons: a Team Lead (institutional strengthening), a Public Financial Management Expert, a Digital Systems and ERP Expert, and a DRM Expert. HR management and GIS expertise are also required.

How to apply
The full Request for Proposals (RFP) is attached to this notice. Submit one email to brave-is@dai.com with the subject "BRAVE-IS-002 - Proposal - [Firm name]", attaching two PDFs: (i) the technical submission, with CVs as an annex, and (ii) the financial proposal, with separate budgets for Stages 1-3 and Stage 4.

Clarification questions must be sent to brave-is@dai.com by 26 October 2026, with the subject "BRAVE-IS-002 - Clarification Question - [Firm name]". Responses will be shared with all bidders without identifying who asked.

Proposals are due by 17:00 Pakistan Standard Time (12:00 UK time) on 4 November 2026 and must remain valid for 90 days. Late submissions will not be considered. Issue of this RFP does not commit DAI to award a contract.

tender.title: Supply Chain Notice: WC1948344 - CIDP26 Islandwide Demolitions, Dhekelia & Episkopi (CYPRUS)
tender.description:
CIDP 26 ISLANDWIDE DEMOLITIONS - DHEKELIA & EPISKOPI STATIONS

Project Scope

The project comprises the demolition of 24 No. assets at Minden Village, Dhekelia, together with the removal of associated infrastructure, with the objective of returning the affected areas to brownfield status. The scope at Dhekelia also incorporates the brownfield conversion of the former Pergamos and Rhine Camp demolition sites. The Episkopi scope comprises the demolition of 9 No. building assets, together with the brownfield conversion of a previously demolished site.

The works include, but are not limited to:

-	Demolition and removal of the identified building assets and associated infrastructure.

-	Removal and appropriate management of asbestos-containing materials, where identified, 
including their temporary storage at the designated Transit Asbestos Compound within the EESA at Akrotiri, in accordance with the applicable requirements and procedures.

-	Removal of all associated underground services and infrastructure.

-	Clearance and removal of demolition arisings, rubble, scrap and other waste materials.

-	Reinstatement and associated earthworks required to return the sites to the specified brownfield condition.

-	Comprehensive recording and maintenance of waste and recyclable material data throughout the works. This shall include, as a minimum, the type, weight, volume and final tipping/disposal site of rubble waste, scrap and other recyclable materials collected and removed from the sites.

-	The Contractor will be required to ensure that all demolition, waste management, asbestos-related activities, transportation, temporary storage, recycling, disposal and site reinstatement activities are undertaken in accordance with the applicable legislation, standards, environmental requirements and project procedures.

Works Excluded from the Tender Scope

A substantial programme of enabling works has already been undertaken in preparation for the project. Accordingly, these completed enabling works do not form part of the scope of this tender.:

-	Isolation of services (water, electricity, telecommunications and sewage).
-	Surveys for asbestos demolition and quantification.
-	Surveys for European Protected Species.
-	VAT Surveys for scrap material.



The Provisional Key Tender dates for the project are as follows:

-	Expression of interest: Friday 16/10/2026
-	Expression of interest return: Thursday 22/10/2026
-	Invitation to Tender: Friday 23/10/2026
-	Tender Return Date: Monday 23/11/2026
-	Contract award: Monday 15/01/2027
-	Commencement of work: Monday 18/01/2027
-	Completion of work: Wednesday 31/03/2027

The currency of this project is Euro (€).
The location of this project is Dhekelia and Episkopi, Cyprus (British Forces).

Additional information: 
Any company wishing to participate in this tender should complete the Pre-Qualification Questionnaire (PQQ) and the EOI form which are attached and return them electronically to the above email address by no later than 12:00 EET on 22/10/2026. 
 
For companies that have submitted a PQQ within the last 12 months, there is no requirement to re-submit it. They must provide the details of their last PQQ submission to guarantee inclusion on the invitation list.  

ATTACHMENTS
Pre-Qualification Questionnaire (PQQ)
Expression of Interest form
